supportingSources.label: Kineticist exact-machine rules and gameplay report

strategy.overview: The Jetsons builds through character collection and two Multiballs. Complete each character's labeled shot to start Jetsons Multiball automatically; for the Cogswell-against-Spacely feature, lock three balls at the left scoop, then shoot the right saucer. Completing both Multiballs lights Jet Screamer at the left scoop.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete each character's labeled shot until all seven names are collected; Jetsons Multiball starts automatically with the final character. The other main route locks three balls at the left Cogswell scoop, then starts Cogswell vs. Spacely Multiball at the right saucer.
strategy.summary: Collect all seven characters by completing their labeled playfield shots; the final character starts Jetsons Multiball automatically. For Cogswell vs. Spacely Multiball, lock three balls at the left Cogswell scoop and then shoot the right Spacely saucer.

quickInfo.name: Jetsons Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete all seven character names; the last collection starts it automatically.

quickInfo.name: Cogswell vs. Spacely
quickInfo.summary: Lock three balls at the left scoop, then shoot the right saucer.

quickInfo.name: Jet Screamer
quickInfo.summary: Complete both earlier Multiballs, then shoot the left Cogswell scoop.

quickInfo.name: Character hurry-up
quickInfo.summary: After collecting a character, hit the captive ball during the lit hurry-up.

steps.text: Follow the seven character names on the playfield and repeat each character's associated shot until that name is complete.
Collect the last remaining character to start Jetsons Multiball automatically; there is no separate start shot after the seventh collection.
For the other main Multiball, shoot the left Cogswell scoop to lock three balls.
After the third lock, shoot the right Spacely saucer to start Cogswell vs. Spacely Multiball.
Complete Jetsons Multiball and Cogswell vs. Spacely Multiball; merely qualifying them is not enough.
When Jet Screamer is lit, shoot the left Cogswell scoop to start it.

machineSetup: Use software v004 when possible; it was released July 27, 2020.
Confirm that the seven character shots, left Cogswell scoop, right Spacely saucer, and captive ball all register before competitive play.

cautions.issue: The two principal Multiballs start differently.
cautions.response: Do not look for a start shot after completing the seventh character; Jetsons Multiball begins immediately. Save the right saucer start for the three-lock Cogswell vs. Spacely route.
